verdict.rationale: Codex can be triggered from GitHub/GitLab/Linear/Slack events to start a task, but there is no evidence of a user-defined rules engine (conditions/triggers configured by the user that automatically fire actions on arbitrary events). The evidence only shows manual task initiation from various surfaces, not an automation/rules system. Missing for 10: user-configurable trigger rules, event-condition-action automation framework, any docs describing 'if X happens, do Y' automation.
